newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan March imported vehicle sales up 12.7% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan March imported vehicle sales up 12.7% yr/yr.

text.p: Domestic sales of imported vehicles in Japan rose 12.7 percent in March from a year earlier to 57,840 units, the Japan Automobile Importers Association (JAIA) said on Friday.
Sales of imported vehicles in the year to March totalled 437,886 units, up 8.8 percent from a previous record of 402,608 set in 1995/96.
It was the third successive month that sales had risen on a year-on-year basis. The March figure was a record high for that month, surpassing the previous March record of 51,342 marked last year.
The sales in 1996/97 marked the fourth straight gain on year-on-year basis.
Of the total, sales of vehicles produced by overseas units of Japanese makers totalled 8,340 in March, down 38.6 percent from a year earlier, bringing the 1996/97 total to 80,425, down 25.1 percent.
